bling_late_night.title: The Bling Bling King Show
bling_late_night.//: Story Phase 11: a late-night comedy programme hosted, from behind a desk, by the Bling Bling King (on television it talks; in person it never has). It knows things it can't know: the hammock over the captain, the Finger-Puller vote, the toy sashes. Nobody explains how. Original jokes; the cast are extra speakers.

episodes.//: Watched in the galley (chapter 109): the designated fart man, the benefits package, fartocracy, sleeping above the captain.

beats.line: announcer: IT'S LATE! IT'S LIVE! IT'S... THE BLING BLING KING, LATE!
bling_king_tv: Thank you. Thank you. Lovely crowd. Lovely STORM out there tonight.
bling_king_tv: So I've been asking myself, folks. Why does a pirate ship have a designated FART MAN?
bling_king_tv: Every other ship's got a cook. A carpenter. A surgeon. This one's got a man whose whole job is the one thing EVERYBODY can already do.
bling_king_tv: And the BENEFITS package. Free beans. Nap authority. A crown. A sash.
bling_king_tv: A pension. For when he retires. From what, folks? From WHAT?
bling_king_tv: They call it an office. I call it a FARTOCRACY.
bling_king_tv: And where does he sleep? In a hammock. Directly. Over. The CAPTAIN.
bling_king_tv: That's not a chain of command, folks. That's a weather system.

episodes.//: On while the captain fights the knobs (and on the channel after): the Grand Court, the Finger-Puller, Hold My Sash, and an advertisement for the Cheap-O-Rama playset.

beats.line: bling_king_tv: Now. The Grand Court. A COURT, folks. For farts. With a JUDGE.
bling_king_tv: 'The Grand Waft is valid.' Who's checking? Who's out there in a wig checking VALIDITY?
bling_king_tv: And they're HIRING. Grand Finger-Puller. No experience. Zero accountability. Sounds like management.
announcer: And now, a sketch. HOLD MY SASH!
bling_king_tv: (in a little cartoon sash) Hold my sash, boys. I'm going IN.
cheapo_voice: Kids! Is your Grand Waft IMAGINARY? Then you need the GRAND STENCHMASTER CEREMONIAL SASH PLAYSET!
cheapo_voice: Two smiling sash holders! Pretend fart noises! Flutter instructions! No real flatulence required!
cheapo_voice: CHEAP-O-RAMA DISCOUNT EMPORIUM. We deliver ANYWHERE.
bling_king_tv: We'll be right back. Don't touch that dial. I MEAN it.

episodes.//: Story Phase 12 (chapter 126), daytime: it knows about the dice, the beans, the breakfast and the thirty seconds. It switches itself on and off. Nobody explains it.

beats.line: announcer: IT'S DAYTIME! IT'S... THE BLING BLING KING, DAYTIME!
bling_king_tv: Big ruling from the Grand Court today, folks. On DICE.
bling_king_tv: Six! Three MONTHS! The crowd goes wild! And then... beans.
bling_king_tv: We don't have pictures of the captain's face at that moment. We have a drawing.
bling_king_tv: One day! The ONE-DAY Stenchmaster crisis. How will he cope? Two hours in, folks. Two hours.
bling_king_tv: Here he is asking a cook to pull his finger. The cook has a LADLE.
announcer: A NORMAL BREAKFAST! Eggs! Bacon! TEA! Brought to you by... nobody. Nobody would sponsor that.
bling_king_tv: No beans, folks. That's not a breakfast. That's a hostage situation.
announcer: And now: our dramatic reconstruction of THE THIRTY SECONDS.
bling_king_tv: (in a very small captain's hat) One! Two! ...Twenty-NINE! THIRTY! LET IT FLUTTER!
announcer: HOLD MY STENCHMASTER! The cartoon sash puffs up all on its own, goes PRRRBBT, and flies away.
announcer: Coming up tonight, a brand-new musical number: DON'T THROW MY SASH IN THE TRASH!
bling_king_tv: Don't touch that dial. Seriously. I'll know.

episodes.//: Story Phase 13 (chapter 128): the number the daytime special promised. It knows the captain wants rid of the sash before he's done anything about it, and it has an answer to every way he might try. Original lyrics. The Bling Bling King sings on television; in person it never says a word.

beats.line: announcer: And now, as promised, a brand-new musical number. Maestro!
bling_king_tv: ♪ Don't throw my sash in the trash! Don't throw my sash in the trash! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ Don't load it in a cannon, don't fire it at the sky! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ It'll only land on somebody, and THEY'LL want to know why! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ Don't throw my sash in the trash! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ Don't tie it to an anchor, don't drop it in the sea! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ An anchor's on a rope, and the rope comes back to ME! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ Don't burn it in the stove, don't bury it in sand, don't lock it in a chest! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ Don't hand it to the garbage crew! They've got enough to do! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ And WHATEVER you do, don't throw it in the Great Sharkstorm... ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ ...'cause the Sharkstorm sends it BACK TO YOU! ♪
shark_chorus: ♪ BACK! TO! YOU! ♪
bling_king_tv: ♪ So hang it in your wardrobe, with your coats, where it belongs! ♪
bling_king_tv: Thank you! 'Don't Throw My Sash in the Trash.' Available now on wax cylinder. From Cheap-O-Rama.
